story.elder.1.a: Welcome to the village! I'm the elder and I remember all the old roads.
story.elder.1.b: Beyond the forest lie the hills. Open the way there and the world grows wider.
story.elder.1.end: The hills! My grandfather herded goats there. It only gets more interesting.
story.elder.2.a: They say the swamp has a mist that remembers the ancients.
story.elder.2.b: Reach the swamp and listen to it.
story.elder.2.end: The mist whispered of caves beneath the mountains. Remember that.
story.elder.3.a: Deep in the caves hides a stone that glows on its own.
story.elder.3.b: Open the way to the caves. An old legend starts there.
story.elder.3.end: The stone points to the sky. The legend speaks of other planets.
story.elder.4.a: You reached Ember! Everything burns here, yet people once lived here too.
story.elder.4.b: Cross the ash plains and find their traces.
story.elder.4.end: The traces lead to a forest where trees froze in amber.
story.elder.5.a: The amber forest keeps the memory of the past.
story.elder.5.b: Get there and see what froze in the resin.
story.elder.5.end: There's a map in the amber! It leads through the fire canyon.
story.elder.6.a: The canyon is dangerous, but the map doesn't lie.
story.elder.6.b: Cross it and we'll learn where the ancients went.
story.elder.6.end: They went further, to a cold blue planet.
story.elder.7.a: Azure! Even from here you can see its meadows shine.
story.elder.7.b: Step onto the star meadows, answers await there.
story.elder.7.end: Stars grow right out of the grass here. The ancients loved this place.
story.elder.8.a: Beyond the meadows rise the frost spires.
story.elder.8.b: The ancients built their towers there. Find the way to them.
story.elder.8.end: On the spire walls is a map of a crystal reef.
story.elder.9.a: The last step is the crystal reef.
story.elder.9.b: There the ancients left their greatest treasure.
story.elder.9.end: The treasure is the home you built. The ancients dreamed of a village like this. Thank you.
story.hint: Villagers move in with every even level of the main house. They live by the house ({0}), but you can also talk to them from here.
story.miller.1.a: The miller, at your service! You have fine fields.
story.miller.1.b: Let's start small: bring me wheat from the beds.
story.miller.1.end: Excellent grain. There will be flour.
story.miller.2.a: The millstones are old and creak across the whole meadow.
story.miller.2.b: Upgrade the mill to level 2 and things will get going.
story.miller.2.end: It spins like new! Hear it sing?
story.miller.3.a: I'll bake a berry pie for the neighbors.
story.miller.3.b: I need flour and wild berries.
story.miller.3.end: The whole village smells it! The first slice is yours.
story.miller.4.a: Blue slimes from the lake crawl into the flour sacks.
story.miller.4.b: Drive them off, the flour is all sticky.
story.miller.4.end: The sacks are clean. Slimes keep away from the mill now.
story.miller.5.a: The harvest festival is coming, everyone wants apple pie.
story.miller.5.b: I need lots of flour and apples.
story.miller.5.end: The best pie in years! The village thanks you.
story.ready: Task done, ready to hand in
story.scholar.1.a: I'm a scholar. I study everything that grows and glows.
story.scholar.1.b: Bring me mushrooms, each has its own secret.
story.scholar.1.end: Fascinating! Noting it in my journal.
story.scholar.2.a: Old skeletons carry scrolls from past ages.
story.scholar.2.b: Defeat them, maybe something valuable turns up.
story.scholar.2.end: A map of the ancient lands! This changes everything.
story.scholar.3.a: I want to build an observatory.
story.scholar.3.end: The walls are up. Only the sky is left.
story.scholar.4.b: Only ice from the snowy peaks will do.
story.scholar.5.a: The last step: a gold frame and diamonds.
story.scholar.5.end: I see it! The fiery planet Ember. One day we'll get there.
story.smith.1.a: Hello, master! I'm the blacksmith, and I'm living here now.
story.smith.1.b: I'll build a forge: wood for the walls and stone for the hearth.
story.smith.1.end: The hearth is burning! The village has a forge now.
story.smith.2.a: A forge without coal is just a stove.
story.smith.2.b: There's coal in the hills. Bring plenty, and some stone too.
story.smith.2.end: Now that's heat! I'll start forging soon.
story.smith.3.a: Orcs from the hills keep stealing my iron.
story.smith.3.b: Chase off five of them so they forget the way here.
story.smith.3.end: It's quiet now. Thanks, my iron is safe.
story.smith.4.a: I need handles for hammers and pickaxes.
story.smith.4.b: Planks from the sawmill will do best.
story.smith.4.end: Fine planks. The handles will be just right.
story.smith.5.a: I want to forge a gate for the village.
story.smith.5.b: Iron and planks, and our estate will be the sturdiest around.
story.smith.5.end: The gate is ready! Any monster will think twice now.
story.tracker.1.a: I'm a tracker. I know every trail from here to the mountains.
story.tracker.1.b: Skeleton rogues have settled in the desert, let's start with them.
story.tracker.1.end: Not bad for a start. The trails are safer now.
story.tracker.2.a: Nobody goes on a long trip without supplies.
story.tracker.2.b: Fish and coconuts keep well on the road.
story.tracker.2.end: Supplies are ready. We can set off.
story.tracker.3.a: Orc warriors roam the snowy peaks.
story.tracker.3.b: Strong but slow. Show them who's in charge.
story.tracker.3.end: You fight better than any of my students.
story.tracker.4.a: We need a camp at the edge of the wild lands.
story.tracker.4.b: Bars for the fittings and planks for the floor.
story.tracker.4.end: The camp is up. You can see all the wild lands from here.
story.tracker.5.a: Dark skeletons have woken in the caves.
story.tracker.5.b: If we don't stop them, they'll come to the village.
story.tracker.5.end: The caves are clear. The village sleeps soundly, and the wild lands await.
story.weaver.1.a: I'm the weaver. I'll sew for the whole village.
story.weaver.1.b: First I need bamboo from the lake to spin thread.
story.weaver.1.end: Strong stalks. The thread will be fine.
story.weaver.2.b: Herbs and berries will make green and red dye.
story.weaver.2.end: What colors! Like a meadow in summer.
story.weaver.3.a: Purple slimes in the swamp hide a rare dye.
story.weaver.3.b: Defeat them and I'll have lilac thread.
story.weaver.3.end: Lilac! Not even the capital has this.
story.weaver.4.b: Slats from the sawmill will help build a new one.
story.weaver.4.end: A new loom! Work will go twice as fast.
story.weaver.5.a: I'll sew festive flags for the village.
story.weaver.5.b: I need clay for stamps and cactus for strong thread.
story.weaver.5.end: Flags over every house! The village looks festive.
